interviewees.organization: Abzena (referred to by the interviewer as 'Xena')
interviewees.org_description: Head of IT at a pharma/biotech company (Abzena) subject to heavy regulation — SOC, ISO, GxP, SOC 2, and GMP/GxP requirements. Previously at Thermo Fisher, described as a Fortune 500 company at roughly $40B revenue with about 2,000 sites and ~2M tickets annually.
interviewees.tenure: About 6 months at Abzena at the time of the interview; previously at Thermo Fisher.
interviewees.background: Currently serves as Senior Director of IT Infrastructure and Operations and head of IT at Abzena, overseeing infrastructure, applications, security and ITSM. Abzena runs a custom ITSM platform that integrates with Microsoft Teams and has AI capabilities; that decision was made by his predecessor, and the company had ServiceNow at one point. He says the removal of ServiceNow left an asset management gap and they are now looking at possibly implementing the ServiceNow asset management piece for GMP equipment and IT assets. At his previous employer, Thermo Fisher, he worked with a large ServiceNow implementation (~$40B company, ~2,000 sites, ~2M tickets annually) spanning Incident, Request, Problem, Change, Knowledge, CMDB, Asset Management, Major Incident Management, HR, and the start of GRC. He described the vendor evaluation there (Jira, Zendesk, BMC, Workday ticket management), the 9-12 month implementation, custom API integration work (SSO with Active Directory, Workday, Databricks), licensing and renewal dynamics, and ongoing platform maintenance staffing.

interviewees.tenure: About four and a half years at Calloway Biosciences; previously six years at a larger CDMO.
interviewees.background: Director of IT Service Management at Calloway Biosciences, a mid-size biopharmaceutical manufacturer, for about four and a half years. Led the migration off a legacy on-prem ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus instance onto BMC Helix ITSM (cloud-hosted) and still owns the platform and the BMC vendor relationship. Prior to Calloway, spent six years at a larger CDMO running a ServiceNow environment, and before that did helpdesk and service management work using smaller on-prem tools. At Calloway the deployed footprint includes Incident, Problem, Change, Service Request Management, Knowledge, CMDB, and Helix Digital Workplace; the full AIOps suite is not enabled. The platform is supported by three people, and integrations include Workday (BMC native connector) and SAP (custom REST API work by an internal integration engineer). Evaluated ServiceNow, Ivanti Neurons for ITSM, Freshservice, and briefly Jira Service Management during selection, and owns budget and licensing decisions including license tiers and add-on SKUs.

Says that when he arrived there was no formal ITSM platform and much work ran through shared inboxes; he led the effort to bring in Freshservice roughly three and a half years ago and still owns that relationship. During selection he evaluated ServiceNow, Ivanti, Zendesk and Freshservice, and cited quoted per-agent pricing for each.
